Avery Exampleton (name used by the campaign, possibly a stolen identity), a name used in fake job interviews

Front Recruiter persona

No real company, person or product was found behind this name.

Reported 2 times, evidence reviewed on 2026-11-01

Also seen as: A. Exampleton (name used by the campaign, possibly a stolen identity)

A recruiter persona that contacts candidates on a business network and moves the talk to a messaging app.

What to do now

If you were sent code, a repository or an app to run as part of an interview like this, do not install or run it. Before your call lists what to do instead.
